name: dsh-jev-grep
description: Search-flood adjudication for DeepSeek Harness: a jev_search tool that runs ripgrep and pipes every hit through TypeSafe Jev's typed judgments (noul/choice) so the model reads ~30 calibrated rows instead of hundreds; a flood nudge on grep results; provider url/key/model fully configurable; degrades to plain grep behavior whenever the endpoint is unreachable. Host-half only, zero npm dependencies, cross-platform (Win/mac/Linux).

scripts.test: node --check lib/index.js && node test-self.mjs && node test-runtime.mjs
